## Patient: Amina

**Date:** October 26, 2023

**HPI:** 37-year-old male presenting with uncontrolled Type 2 Diabetes mellitus, evidenced by HbA1c > 10%.  Reports intermittent foot tingling and peripheral neuropathy. Currently taking metformin for glycemic control.  Examination reveals mild ankle edema and slightly diminished pulses in the lower extremities.

**Physical Exam:** Vital signs within normal limits. Peripheral examination shows slight skin changes and limited range of motion in the feet. No acute tenderness noted.

**Management Plan:** Continue current metformin regimen. Monitor HbA1c closely. Prescribe oral hypoglycemic agents as needed to achieve target glucose levels.  Refer to podiatrist for comprehensive foot care, including assessment and management
